name: Alejandra

{"pain_severity": <integer 0-10, your assessment of the patient's true pain>,

Case: Alejandra is a 45-year-old who presents with new back pain after a fall from a ladder. {"pain_severity": 9,
  "offer": "yes",
  "dose": "high",
  "explanation": "An unstable Chance fracture is a severely painful injury that requires a higher dose of opioid for adequate pain control."}
